shape.gear.summary: Generate a spur gear with locally computed involute flanks: a root disc, a sampled-involute tooth extruded and circular-patterned, plus optional bore/hub/key. Returns feature, bodies, healthState, message, diameters, toothCount, undercut and regeneration evidence.

inputs.name: Required feature name; reserves root/tooth/bore/hub/key helper names.
inputs.module: Positive module length expression; pitch d = module*teeth.
inputs.teeth: Positive integer tooth count; the circular pattern quantity.
inputs.pressureAngle: Angular expression, default 20 deg; base diameter db = d*cos(pressureAngle).
inputs.system: metric (default, ha=1.0 hf=1.25) or short (ha=0.8 hf=1.0); explicit addendumCoefficient/dedendumCoefficient override.
inputs.profileShift: Finite numeric profile shift coefficient x.
inputs.rootTreatment: straight or trochoidal (default); trochoidal reports a root fillet radius of 0.38*module.
inputs.toothThicknessReduction: Nonnegative length subtracted from the pitch tooth thickness.
inputs.backlashAllocation: Nonnegative circular backlash length attributed to this gear.
inputs.bore: Positive bore diameter; a native hole through the blank.
inputs.hub: Descriptor {diameter,height}; a boss extruded onto the gear.
inputs.key: Descriptor {width,depth}; a rectangular keyway cut through the face width.
inputs.plane: Native construction plane, default XY; mutually exclusive with frame.
inputs.frame: Named datum.frame or frame descriptor orienting the gear plane.
inputs.flankTolerance: Positive length controlling involute sampling density, default 0.001 mm.

limitations: The involute flank is a sampled chordal polyline (line segments whose sagitta stays below flankTolerance); tip and root radii are driving expressions but the flank is a recipeRegeneration snapshot. d=mz, db=d*cos(alpha), da=m(z+2ha+2x), df=m(z-2hf+2x) for the standard system.

Undercut is detected when teeth fall below 2*(ha-x)/sin^2(alpha). The below-base-circle transition is a radial line (straight) or a reported root fillet (trochoidal), not a native trochoidal generator. Recipe is not atomic and requires component scope.

gear.pair-check.summary: Check a gear pair: signed ratio, center distance, phase, working pressure angle and total backlash over the tooth cycle. Read-only local involute model; no geometry mutation.

inputs.gear2: Second gear descriptor sharing the same module.
inputs.external: Boolean, default true; false models internal gearing with a signed ratio.
inputs.centerDistance: Optional operating center distance; computes the working pressure angle from the base diameters.

limitations: Ratio sign flips for internal gearing. Backlash is the sum of the two declared per-gear allocations and thickness reductions, not an unconditional split of one value. Working angle assumes involute contact at the declared center distance. Read-only; no document mutation and no native feature is created.
